content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on present perfect for an unfinished period and past simple for a finished starting event. Notice how the ideas about volunteering at a community garden are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: I have volunteered at a community garden for six months, and the experience has made me more confident. I joined my first Saturday session in March.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about volunteering at a community garden. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
